item.title: Learnings from paying artists royalties for AI-generated art
item.description:
📝 We reached out to 11 illustration agencies about getting their artists on Tess. 4% of artists were hard nos. High-end artists worried that enabling anyone to generate in their style would cheapen it.
🔗 Read more: https://www.kapwing.com/blog/learnings-from-paying-artists-royalties-for-ai-generated-art/

item.title: I don't know Apple's endgame for the Fn/Globe key–or if Apple does
item.description:
📝 But there already were 10 function keys on other keyboards. But the Fn convention stuck; even though the laptop actually came with 10 proper function keys atop, a few other missing keys still needed representation. Just like in 1984, Fn was used to make keys pretend they’re Home, End, PgUp, PgDn, plus a few more rare keys like Break or PrtSc.
🔗 Read more: https://aresluna.org/fn/
